items.name: Molten Cake
items.desc: Dark chocolate cake with a warm, flowing centre. Warm for 15 seconds before serving.
items.ingredients: 70% dark chocolate, unsalted butter, whole eggs and extra egg yolks, sugar, a spoonful of plain flour, a pinch of salt. Finished with a dusting of icing sugar. Contains: eggs, dairy, gluten.

items.name: Brownies
items.desc: Dense, fudgy dark-chocolate brownies with a crackly top.
items.ingredients: Dark chocolate (60–70% cocoa), unsalted butter, white sugar, light brown sugar, eggs, plain flour, Dutch-process cocoa, a touch of espresso to deepen the chocolate, vanilla, salt. Contains: eggs, dairy, gluten.

items.name: Carrot Cake
items.desc: Spiced carrot and toasted pecan sponge layered with cream cheese frosting.
items.ingredients: Sponge: freshly grated carrots, toasted pecans, plain flour, sugar, sunflower oil, buttermilk, eggs, cinnamon, vanilla, baking powder, baking soda, salt. Frosting: cream cheese, unsalted butter, icing sugar, vanilla. Contains: eggs, dairy, gluten, nuts (pecans).

items.name: Honey Cake
items.desc: Ten thin layers of burnt-honey cake with dulce de leche cream, rested overnight to soften.
items.ingredients: Cake layers: honey (part of it slowly caramelised), unsalted butter, sugar, eggs, plain flour, baking soda, cinnamon, salt. Cream: fresh whipping cream, dulce de leche, burnt honey, a pinch of salt. Coated in toasted honey-cake crumbs. Contains: eggs, dairy, gluten.

items.name: Soufflé Cheesecake
items.desc: Light, airy Japanese-style cheesecake that melts in the mouth.
items.ingredients: Cream cheese, fresh cream, unsalted butter, eggs (the yolks in the batter, the whites whipped into a meringue with sugar), cake flour, lemon zest and juice. Baked slowly in a water bath, glazed with apricot and topped with fresh berries. Contains: eggs, dairy, gluten.

items.name: Crème Caramel
items.desc: Silky vanilla custard under a dark, glossy caramel that turns to sauce as it rests. Run a knife around and turn it onto a plate.
items.ingredients: Fresh milk, cream, whole eggs and egg yolks, sugar, vanilla; a dark caramel of sugar and water. Baked gently in a water bath. Contains: eggs, dairy. Gluten-free.

items.name: Crème Brûlée
items.desc: Rich vanilla custard with a thin sugar crust, torched just before it leaves our kitchen. Keep chilled and enjoy within two hours for the crack.
items.ingredients: Fresh cream, egg yolks, sugar, vanilla, a pinch of salt; topped with demerara sugar caramelised by flame. Contains: eggs, dairy. Gluten-free.
